abstract: Congenital cervical teratomas are rare, representing 3% of teratomas in childhood. Although mostly benign, they are associated with a high mortality rate due to respiratory distress and require immediate surgical excision. The diagnosis is usually suggested on the physical examination. The imaging investigation is essential for the proper diagnosis and preoperative planning. We present the imaging characteristics of cervical teratomas identified in five neonates over a 10-year-period. The masses were surgically resected. Histopathology revealed the presence of congenital teratomas (three immature, two mature). Two neonates died soon after surgery, while the remaining were discharged from the hospital without symptoms.
abstract_ja: 先天性頸部奇形腫は小児期の奇形腫の3%を占める稀な腫瘍である。多くは良性であるが、呼吸窮迫により死亡率が高く、直ちに外科的切除が必要である。診断は通常、身体診察で疑われる。画像検査は正確な診断と術前計画に不可欠である。10年間に新生児5例で認められた頸部奇形腫の画像所見を示す。腫瘤は外科的に切除された。病理組織学的所見では、先天性奇形腫が認められた（未熟型3例、成熟型2例）。新生児2例は術後まもなく死亡し、残りの症例は症状なく退院した。
